quote: When the signal is circular green alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal may proceed across the highway within any marked or unmarked crosswalk, unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].

activation.description: Pedestrian faces a circular-green-alone signal at first crosswalk entry.
activation.source_clause: When the signal is circular green alone

obligation.description: Conditional permission to proceed across a marked or unmarked crosswalk; no violation label follows from this permission.
obligation.source_clause: may proceed across the highway within any marked or unmarked crosswalk

exceptions.source_clause: unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
exceptions.description: Another governing pedestrian device may direct otherwise under the cited NRS 484B.283 provisions.

timing.description: Measure displayed indication and governing direction at first crosswalk entry, then retain crossing history.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
judgment_calls_needed.note: Whether another device physically directs this crossing requires original pixel, facing, and governance review.
